DataRequest.description:
A frozen, hashable description of exactly what data to load.

Attributes:
    provider: Identifier of the data provider, e.g. `"synthetic"`.
    symbols: Symbols to load, sorted and unique; empty when the provider resolves an index or
        filter universe (see `params["universe_kind"]`).
    range: Calendar date range to load.
    frequency: Finest bar frequency to load.
    calendar: Exchange calendar used to interpret the range and frequency.
    instrument_kind: The kind of instrument the request is for.
    seed: Seed for any stochastic provider.
    params: Provider-specific settings. An unresolved universe is passed through the reserved
        keys `"universe_kind"` and (for an index) `"universe_index"`.

calendar.description: Exchange calendar identifier used to interpret range/frequency.
calendar.title: Calendar

instrument_kind.description: The kind of instrument the request is for.

provider.description: Identifier of the data provider to load from.
provider.title: Provider

symbols.description: Symbols to load, sorted and unique; empty when the provider must resolve them.
symbols.title: Symbols

DataRequest.title: DataRequest

DateRange.description:
An inclusive calendar date range used for data windows and search windows.

Attributes:
    start: First date included in the range.
    end: Last date included in the range.

end.description: Last date included in the range.
end.title: End

start.description: First date included in the range.
start.title: Start

DateRange.title: DateRange

EquityCoverage.description:
How completely the lake covers one equity ticker over a load's range.

Attributes:
    source_gap_sessions: Expected sessions inside a membership span of `sp500_price_coverage`
        with no bar: the lake should hold them and does not.
    by_construction_sessions: Expected sessions outside every membership span with no bar (the
        lake holds a member's bars only during membership plus its fill windows).
    yahoo_daily_share: Share of the ticker's bars whose `equity_daily_from_bars.source` is
        `yahoo_daily`.

by_construction_sessions.description: Missing sessions outside every membership span.
by_construction_sessions.title: By Construction Sessions

yahoo_daily_share.description: Share of bars filled from Yahoo daily.
yahoo_daily_share.title: Yahoo Daily Share

EquityCoverage.title: EquityCoverage

Frequency.description:
Bar frequency at which a schedule decides or data is sampled.

Members are ordered from finest to coarsest. The string value (e.g. ``"1d"``) is what appears in
YAML/JSON specs and in the JSON Schema.
Frequency.title: Frequency

QualityCount.description:
One structured data-quality action a provider took while building a bundle.

Attributes:
    rule: The invariant the rows violated, e.g. `"ohlc_consistency"`, `"non_positive_price"`.
    action: `"dropped"` (removed) or `"repaired"` (kept, values clipped or filled).
    n_rows: How many rows the action touched.
    frame: The bundle frame the rows belong to (`"bars"`, `"option_chains"`, ...).

n_rows.description: Number of rows the action touched.
n_rows.title: N Rows

QualityCount.title: QualityCount

description:
Provenance and guarantees of a `DataBundle`, separate from the data itself.

Only `request` (not these fields) enters `snapshot_id`.

Attributes:
    provider: Name of the provider that produced the bundle.
    request: The request that was fulfilled.
    is_demo: Whether the provider is demo-only (survivorship-biased, no point-in-time
        membership, vendor-adjusted).
    is_synthetic: Whether the data is generated, not observed, so a comparison with real
        market series (factor returns, a risk-free rate) has no meaning.
    warnings: Human-readable caveats about this bundle.
    survivorship_free: Whether delisted names remain in the universe.
    point_in_time_membership: Whether index membership reflects each historical date.
    prices_adjusted: Whether `bars.close` is already split-adjusted (provider-declared, not
        verified), so a close-to-close ratio near a split ratio is not an unadjusted split.
    quality_counts: Structured counts of rows dropped or repaired while building (the audit's
        `ohlc_consistency` check echoes the OHLC entries).
    untraded_symbols: `BARS.symbol` values loaded only as benchmark or reference series, never
        traded; a futures bundle exempts them from the every-symbol-has-a-contract rule.
    declared_starts: Per symbol the provider could not serve from the requested start, the first
        date it has data (e.g. a truncated futures root); empty otherwise.
    lake_time: The lake time T the bundle was read as of (ISO 8601, UTC); `None` for a bundle
        not read from the lake.
    lake_version: The lake's `X-Lakehouse-Version` as received (a `-dirty` suffix is kept);
        `None` for a bundle not read from the lake.
    lake_current_tables: Tables read without a log, so at the lake version rather than at
        `lake_time`; `None` for a bundle not read from the lake.
    equity_coverage: Per equity ticker with a membership span, its missing sessions split into
        source gaps and by-construction stops, and its Yahoo share; `None` when not measured.

declared_starts.description: Per request.symbols entry, the first date the provider states it has data for, when it could not serve the requested start.
